query:
INSERT INTO captured_files (run_id, path, size, hash, storage_path, content_type)
                        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
                        ON CONFLICT (run_id, path) DO UPDATE
                        SET size = EXCLUDED.size,
                            hash = EXCLUDED.hash,
                            storage_path = EXCLUDED.storage_path,
                            content_type = EXCLUDED.content_type
